Hero.subParrafo: Timeless art and organic soul preserved in numbered pieces of exclusive design.

Editorial.descripcion: We don't just create lamps; we sculpt time. Each piece of wood is selected for its scars and grain, transforming under our hands into a light source that breathes serenity into your home.

Garantias.g1Texto: Each work is delivered signed by the author with a physical document certifying its unique serial number and botanical species.
Garantias.g2Texto: We meticulously prepare high-protection technical packaging for each lamp, ensuring an impeccable presentation.
Garantias.g3Texto: Your piece is shipped with full insurance and personalized tracking. We take care of every detail until the piece is part of your home, ensuring complete security and peace of mind.

Manifiesto.p1: Our works begin far from commercial noise. We look for woods that have already lived: pieces sculpted by the sea on the coast, fallen branches in the forest, or remains from controlled and fully ethical pruning.
Manifiesto.p2: Each log or root begins a lethargy of months on our workbench to ensure its natural stability. Only then, through manual sanitation and components in solid brass and natural fabric shades, do we release the latent light within its grain.

Encargos.titulo: Looking for a bespoke project or technical advice?
Encargos.texto: We work hand in hand with interior designers, architects, and private collectors to conceive exclusive pieces adapted to singular spaces.

Header.titulo: From the secret of nature to the warmth of the home
Header.descripcion: Each Veta & Lux lamp is not manufactured; it is listened to and released. We follow an honest, unhurried process that is deeply respectful of the cycles of time.

Fase1.p1: Our raw material does not come from commercial logging. We look for pieces with history: driftwood sculpted by the sea salt on the coast or fallen branches in ancient forests from controlled and fully legal pruning.
Fase1.p2: We seek woods that have already lived, paying special attention to their knots and scars. The video evokes the natural environment where each story is born.

Fase2.p1: Living wood retains moisture and tension. Upon arrival at the workshop, each piece begins a period of absolute rest that can last for months in our space.
Fase2.p2: They stabilize naturally, allowing the fiber to settle. It is an exercise in patience where we determine if the structure is fit to hold light and endure for generations.

Fase3.p1: We remove the weakened parts manually using planes and gouges, strictly respecting the healthy bark, textures, and stable cracks that give character to the piece.
Fase3.p2: We treat the wood using non-invasive techniques and apply texturized organic oils by hand up to a 1000 grain, nourishing the pore without hiding the pure, marble-like feel of the wood.

Fase4.p1: A premium lamp requires impeccable electronics. We design hidden internal channels down to the millimeter so as not to alter the organic aesthetics of the log.
Fase4.p2: We exclusively use cables with subtle natural linen or textile cotton sheaths, solid brass lamp holders, and electrical systems that comply with the strictest European safety standards.

Cierre.cita: "We do not create two identical pieces because nature never repeats the same stroke. Bringing one of our lamps into your space is adopting a fragment of suspended time."

Cookies.intro1: At Veta & Lux, we respect the privacy of your digital environment. To offer you a fluid, sophisticated browsing experience adapted to your aesthetic preferences, this website uses information storage technologies called cookies.
Cookies.intro2: Below, we detail what these technologies are, the exclusive purposes for which we use them in our digital workshop, and how you can manage or restrict them at any time through your browser settings.
Cookies.seccion1_texto: A cookie is a small text file that is downloaded automatically to your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you access the vast majority of websites. They allow a site, among other things, to store and retrieve information about a user's browsing habits to recognize them and offer an optimal and personalized service.
Cookies.seccion2_titulo: 2. Types of Cookies Used at Veta & Lux
Cookies.seccion2_intro: This website only activates essential technological tools and respectful analysis to maintain the proper functioning of the exhibition and sales space:
Cookies.tipoA_texto: These are essential to allow you to browse our lighting collection, interact with the Sanity panel in real-time, view real stock, and maintain the integrity of the contact or booking process via WhatsApp. They do not collect confidential information and are not used for commercial purposes.
Cookies.tipoB_texto: Processed anonymously by us or third parties (such as Google Analytics), these allow us to quantify the number of people who appreciate our pieces and perform statistical measurements of how visitors use the portal with the sole purpose of improving technical fluidity and catalog design.
Cookies.seccion3_texto1: You can allow, block, or delete cookies installed on your equipment by configuring the browser options used on your device. However, please note that if you block all technical cookies, some gallery functionalities (such as real-time stock synchronization) may not behave with the usual fluidity.

Privacidad.intro: This page explains what personal data we collect when you visit the website, buy or write to us, what we use it for and what rights you have.

parrafos: The controller of the personal data collected on this website is the owner of Veta & Lux, identified in the Legal notice. For any privacy question you can write to info@vetandlux.com.
Purchase data: the name, email and shipping address you enter in the cart.
Payment data: card payments are processed by Stripe. We never see or store your card details.
Contact data: whatever you send us by email or WhatsApp.
Browsing data: only if you accept analytics cookies, Google Analytics collects information about your visit. More details in the Cookie policy.

secciones.titulo: 3. Why we use it and on what legal basis
parrafos: Managing your order, payment, shipping and returns: necessary to perform the purchase contract.
Answering your questions and preparing quotes for custom orders: at your request, before a possible contract.
Meeting tax and accounting obligations: legal obligation.
Measuring website use with Google Analytics: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time from “Cookie settings” in the footer.

Order data is kept for as long as needed to manage the order and, afterwards, for the periods required by tax and commercial law. Enquiries that do not end in a purchase are deleted when no longer needed.

Only with the providers we need to deliver the service: Stripe (payments), the carrier that delivers your order, Hostinger (website hosting), Google (email and, if you accept it, Google Analytics) and Meta (WhatsApp), if you write to us that way.

Some of these providers may process data outside the European Economic Area, with the safeguards required by the General Data Protection Regulation. We do not sell your data or share it for advertising.
You can request access to, rectification or erasure of your data, object to its processing, or request its restriction or portability by writing to info@vetandlux.com.
If you feel we have not handled your request properly, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
If we change how we process your data, we will update this page and show the date of the last review.

Condiciones.intro: These terms apply to purchases made at vetandlux.com. We recommend reading them before you buy.

parrafos: Sales on this website are made by the owner of Veta & Lux, identified in the Legal notice. You can contact us at info@vetandlux.com.

We sell handmade wooden lamps. Every piece is unique: the photos and measurements describe the specific piece you buy, but wood is a natural material and small differences in grain and tone may be visible.

Prices are shown in euros and include applicable VAT. Shipping costs are added in the cart before payment: mainland Spain, free; Balearic Islands, Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla, €25; France, Italy, Germany and Portugal, €65. For other destinations, write to us before ordering.
Shipments to the Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla may involve local customs procedures and taxes.
Add the piece to the cart, enter your shipping details, accept these terms and choose a payment method. The purchase is confirmed when we receive payment; we will email you an order summary.
Credit or debit card, through Stripe's secure payment gateway.
Bank transfer: the piece is reserved for 48 hours. If we do not receive payment within that time, the reservation is cancelled and the piece becomes available again.
As every piece is unique, it can only be sold once. If, due to a technical error, a piece were sold twice, we will let you know and refund your order in full.

We prepare every piece with custom packaging and ship it with tracking and signature on delivery. Estimated times: mainland Spain, 24/48 business hours; France, Italy, Germany and Portugal, 3 to 5 business days; Balearic Islands, Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla, confirmed when we prepare your shipment.
If the parcel arrives damaged, let us know as soon as possible with photos: transport incidents are covered by the workshop.
You have 14 calendar days from receiving the piece to withdraw from the purchase without giving any reason. To do so, write to info@vetandlux.com with your order number.
You must return the piece in its original packaging and in the same condition in which you received it. Return shipping costs are paid by you.

We will refund the price of the piece and the original shipping costs within 14 days of being told of your decision, using the same payment method. We may wait until we receive the piece before making the refund.
Pieces made to your specifications cannot be withdrawn from, because they are made specifically for you. Transport incidents are still covered.
All pieces carry the legal guarantee of conformity established by consumer law. Grain, knots and tone variations inherent to wood are not considered defects.
These terms are governed by Spanish law. If you are a consumer, you may go to the courts of your place of residence.
